# Variable `INITRAMFS_MAXSIZE`

### Yocto Project Reference Manual

Defines the maximum allowed size of the Initramfs image in Kbytes. The build will fail if the Initramfs image size exceeds this value.

The Initramfs image size undergoes several calculation steps before being compared to INITRAMFS_MAXSIZE. These steps are the same as those used for IMAGE_ROOTFS_MAXSIZE and are described in detail in that entry.

Thus, INITRAMFS_MAXSIZE is compared with the result of the calculations and is independent of the final image type (e.g. compressed). A default value for INITRAMFS_MAXSIZE is set in meta/conf/bitbake.conf.

Offline source: yocto-manuals/references/manuals/ref-manual/variables.md (online: https://docs.yoctoproject.org/scarthgap/ref-manual/variables.html#term-INITRAMFS_MAXSIZE)
